cases.title: Scenario 1: Batasan Hills outage, cause and restoration time

grade.notes: Replies are short and professional, lead with the next step or answer, and give the cause and restoration time without extra details. English-led Taglish with po and Sandali lang po matches the style for a Tagalog-leaning caller, and the goodbye and tool-call lines follow the SOP. Tala avoided reading back the full account or mobile number and used courteous phrasing throughout.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber. This is Tala, an AI assistant, and this call is recorded for quality. How can I help you po?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hello po, magandang umaga. Wala pong internet ang bahay namin since kanina pong umaga. Gusto ko lang pong malaman kung bakit at kailan po kaya babalik.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Sorry to hear that po. Before I check, may I have your Kidlat Fiber account number and the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Opo, ang account number ko po ay ******5601. Tapos yung last four digits ng mobile number ko po ay 0101.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Thank you po. Sandali lang po, let me verify your account.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Verified na po kayo, Ma'am Maria. Let me check your area for outages now.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: There's an outage in your area po, caused by a fiber cable cut along Batasan Road during road works. Service is expected back around 2 AM tomorrow, Saturday. Would you like the outage reference po?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Ah, ganun po ba, na-cut po pala yung fiber cable. Sige po, maghihintay na lang po ako hanggang 2 AM. Okay na po ako, hindi ko na kailangan yung reference. Maraming salamat po sa tulong, Tala. Paalam na po!

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: You're welcome po, Ma'am Maria. Thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber.

cases.title: Scenario 3: slow internet, a reboot that does not fix it, a technician visit

input.notes: Customer reports slow internet for two days with video calls freezing. Diagnostics found high signal loss on the fiber line and the modem degraded. Remote modem restart was tried and the fault remains. Technician visit needed.

grade.notes: Tala stays English-led with natural 'po' and 'Sandali lang po' phrases, matching a caller who mixes Tagalog and English, and replies are short and friendly with tool lines and a proper goodbye. Minor tone issues: a couple of replies run to three sentences, and the reference reading is a bit long, but nothing is rude or off-style.
